abstract: BACKGROUND: The p21WAF1/CIP1 gene mediates growth arrest by inhibiting G1 cyclin dependent kinases and has been considered as a downstream effector of the tumour suppressor gene p53. AIM: To analyse the role of p21WAF1/CIP1 in gestational trophoblastic disease. METHODS: The immunohistochemical expression of p21WAF1/CIP1 gene was measured in 33 placentas, 28 partial hydatidiform moles, 54 complete hydatidiform moles, and 13 choriocarcinomas in paraffin wax embedded tissue. The results were correlated with p53 (DO7) and Ki67 (MIB1) immunoreactivity as well as clinical progress. RESULTS: p21WAF1/CIP1 immunoreactivity was found predominantly in the nuclei of the syncytiotrophoblasts. p21WAF1/CIP1 protein expression correlated with gestational age in normal placentas (p = 0.0001) but not in hydatidiform moles (p = 0.89). Complete hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas had a significantly higher p21WAF1/CIP1 expression compared with normal placentas and partial hydatidiform moles (p < 0.001); there was no difference between placentas and partial hydatidiform moles. No correlation between p21WAF1/CIP1 expression and either the proliferation (Ki67) index (p = 0.34) or p53 protein accumulation (p = 0.68) was demonstrated. There was no significant difference (p > 0.05) in p21WAF1/CIP1 expression between the 17 patients who developed persistent gestational trophoblastic disease and those who did not. CONCLUSIONS: This study suggests that p21WAF1/CIP1 expression in trophoblastic disease may be induced by a p53 independent pathway. The proliferative activity of gestational trophoblastic diseases might not be determined solely by the control of the cell cycle operated by p21WAF1/CIP1. p21WAF1/CIP1 expression is not an accurate prognostic indicator of gestational trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 背景：p21WAF1/CIP1遺伝子はG1期サイクリン依存性キナーゼを阻害することで増殖停止を媒介し、腫瘍抑制遺伝子p53の下流エフェクターとみなされてきた。目的：妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるp21WAF1/CIP1の役割を解析すること。方法：パラフィン包埋組織で、胎盤33例、部分胞状奇胎28例、完全胞状奇胎54例、絨毛癌13例のp21WAF1/CIP1発現を免疫組織化学的に測定した。結果はp53（DO7）およびKi67（MIB1）の免疫反応性および臨床経過と相関させた。結果：p21WAF1/CIP1の免疫反応性は主に合胞栄養膜細胞の核に認められた。p21WAF1/CIP1蛋白発現は正常胎盤では在胎週数と相関したが（p=0.0001）、胞状奇胎では相関しなかった（p=0.89）。完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌は正常胎盤および部分胞状奇胎より有意に高いp21WAF1/CIP1発現を示した（p<0.001）。胎盤と部分胞状奇胎の間に差はなかった。p21WAF1/CIP1発現は増殖指標（Ki67）（p=0.34）およびp53蛋白蓄積（p=0.68）のいずれとも相関しなかった。持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を発症した17例と発症しなかった患者の間で、p21WAF1/CIP1発現に有意差はなかった（p>0.05）。結論：本研究は、絨毛性疾患におけるp21WAF1/CIP1発現がp53非依存性経路によって誘導される可能性を示唆する。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の増殖活性は、p21WAF1/CIP1が担う細胞周期制御だけでは決まらない可能性がある。p21WAF1/CIP1発現は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の正確な予後指標ではない。
